title: JackPack-Rosewood
description: a pack i made for me and my sister. focuses mostly on coziness and farming.
body:
Modpack made for me and my sister. Focuses on farming, husbandry, cooking. Intended to be played on Peaceful, Easy, or without Hostile Mob Spawns.

Features:
Farming integration with mods like Farmer's Delight. (and its many add-ons)
The Let's Go series of mods to further give a fleshed out feeling to animals.
Fresh Animations resource pack along with its Extras.
Immersive Instruments
Immersive Armor
Foliage
Worldgen
And much more!
